verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers hybrid text+vector search and RRF fusion, but nothing addresses the specific story of custom ranking rules incorporating business signals like popularity, recency, or margin (e.g., function_score, script_score, rank_feature fields) — Elasticsearch's actual mechanisms for this are not cited anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: any citation to function_score query, script_score, boosting by field values, rank_feature/rank_features field types, or decay functions for recency/popularity-based scoring.
